text:
**C. Involuntary manslaughter.** The defendant intended only a slight leg wound, so he lacked intent to kill or cause grievous bodily harm. Shooting a gun at someone is also arguably not "depraved heart" recklessness on these facts, since he aimed at a leg. The killing is best classified as a death resulting from an unlawful act (battery with a firearm), which is involuntary manslaughter. Murder would need malice, and the common-law bar for it isn't met here.

CONFIDENCE: 55
